summary: The main viewing screens are usable, but the broken phone show page, truncated settings and weak secondary-text contrast prevent this baseline from being ready to ship.

top_changes.change: Replace the fixed desktop positioning with a full-width phone layout: 16–24 dp side padding, cards filling the available width, two-line titles, and a heading below the system safe area.
top_changes.why: The heading overlaps the status bar, episode cards are severely clipped, and most of the screen provides no usable information.

top_changes.element: Settings row cards and their title/subtitle labels
top_changes.change: Use wider tiles in two rows or a vertical list; show complete setting names and allow two subtitle lines instead of truncating almost every label.
top_changes.why: Labels such as 'Stream ...', 'Visual T...' and 'Customi...' hide what the controls do.

top_changes.element: Recent Videos and Browse Shows headers, plus video-card text panels
top_changes.change: Raise row-header contrast to approximately #B8B8B8 or brighter and use opaque dark card footers so backdrop lettering cannot show through titles.
top_changes.why: Dim section labels are difficult to read from a sofa, and background artwork competes with the focused card's title.

top_changes.element: Focused first result and adjacent result cards
top_changes.change: Reserve space for focus enlargement or reduce the scale so the focused card keeps at least a 24 px visible gap from its neighbour; allow two title lines in fixed-height footers.
top_changes.why: The enlarged first result crowds the second card, while long neighbouring titles lose their meaning through clipping.

top_changes.element: Transport-control focus state and bottom seek controls
top_changes.change: Give the remote-focused control a distinct outer ring or coloured background independent of its icon; inset the seek track and settings button at least 48 px from screen edges.
top_changes.why: The white Play icon does not clearly establish remote focus, and the seek thumb touches the left edge with little protection against TV overscan.

already_good: TV detail has a clear title and a prominent, visibly focused Watch Now action.
Focused video cards generally stand out through an outline and enlargement.
Phone player correctly places readable details and Up Next below the video.
Downloads empty states explain how to save a video.
The theme picker uses large rows, readable descriptions and an explicit selection checkmark.
